title: Profiled coefficient rigidity for submacroscopic Fourier-block laws

coefficient_theorem.class: Normalized stationary positive-amplitude finite-Fisher finite-fourth-moment laws with central symmetry, uniformly profile-bounded covariance, uniformly bounded standardized directional block cumulants and independent blocks of size b_N=o(N^3).
coefficient_theorem.lower_bound: K1637 and K1642 give Q_N-lambda_N^statG=A_N+R_(Omega,N)/4+gD_N>=-o(N^4) for every fixed g>0.
coefficient_theorem.upper_bound: The K1572 profiled Gaussian belongs to the class and supplies lambda_N^statG.
coefficient_theorem.remaining_endpoint: A coefficient-changing block-law competitor must use a macroscopic Omega(N^3) dependence block or leave another load-bearing uniform hypothesis.
coefficient_theorem.scope_guard: The theorem does not control one macroscopic correlated block, identify the unrestricted coefficient, restore bounded-error Gaussian recentering or supply a source-owned Hamiltonian.
